question: Does the retained Passive-expiration receiver-time field preserve or improve whole-portfolio economics outside its original 2025 path when independently reconstructed on the frozen CP2 baseline?
excluded_sources: current Live-Dev source, state, logs, terminal and broker state
transition-reserve source or outcomes as an implementation dependency

frozen_parent.copy_rule: One-time self-contained copy into this family; no cross-family Include, link or execution dependency.

causal_information_boundary.emitter_birth: A Passive opportunity becomes an expired-unfilled emitter only when ORDER_STATE_EXPIRED is actually observed by the EA. The stored emitter server time is that observation time, not its scheduled expiration.
causal_information_boundary.receiver_cutoff: A receiver may use only emitters whose observed server second is strictly earlier than the receiver decision second.
allowed: observed expired-unfilled Passive direction and observation server time
current Return or Cross signal direction at its frozen decision second
current Cross POSITION_PROFIT at the first processed native four-H1-bar maturity boundary
all frozen CP2 position identity, entry risk, session and reconciliation state
forbidden: future prices, future exit outcomes or post-trade MFE
special dates, post-outcome thresholds or strategy exceptions beyond the two declared receivers
broker history or Live account state

fixed_paths.definition: Frozen CP2 V7 economics. Afterimage telemetry is inert and every natural hold remains unchanged.
CONTROL plus the declared Return qualification. A qualified admitted Return lifecycle closes after three H1 bars instead of its native six H1 bars. Cross remains native.

RETURN_CONTRACTION plus the declared Cross qualification. At the first processed native four-H1-bar maturity boundary, a qualified Cross lifecycle extends to six H1 bars only when POSITION_PROFIT is strictly positive; otherwise it remains due for native close. The maturity choice is frozen on first observation.

return.energy: sum of every eligible emitter weight
return.signed_energy: sum of weight multiplied by +1 for same direction and -1 for opposite direction

cross.qualification: At least one strictly earlier eligible emitter has the same direction as the current Cross signal and age <= 2880 minutes.
cross.extension_gate: POSITION_PROFIT > 0 at the first processed native maturity boundary

implementation_contract.capacity_rule: Prune emitters older than eight Return half-lives before insertion; fail closed with a safety stop if 64 still-live emitters would be exceeded.
unchanged: all six signal formulas and decision times
all order types, entry prices and volumes
initial stop construction and RC4 compression
margin, sizing, session clock and calendar
RC16, RC4, Pressure and Passive exits
required_telemetry: observed expired emitter count and capacity faults
Return qualification count, admitted qualified lifecycles and three-bar releases
Cross qualification count, admitted qualified lifecycles, native maturity decisions, extensions and native closes
qualification energy and dominance or matching-emitter count

per_path_operational_requirements: All four runs end with one normal STOP.
Zero safety, persistence, broker-identity, foreign-exposure, protection, ownership or afterimage-capacity fault.
MT5 report net, trade and deal totals reconcile to final component snapshots and preserved evidence.
Each candidate has at least 20 admitted qualified receiver lifecycles pooled across four periods.
No candidate has fewer completed portfolio trades than CONTROL in any period or pooled.
full_candidate_requirements_vs_control: Summed stressed net must exceed CONTROL by at least max(USD 5, 5% of absolute CONTROL summed stressed net).
Stressed net must be at least CONTROL in at least three of four periods.
Actual net must be at least CONTROL in at least three of four periods.
Summed stressed maximum closed drawdown must not exceed CONTROL.
No period stressed maximum closed drawdown may exceed CONTROL by more than 15%.
combined_attribution_requirements: RECEIVER_TIME_FIELD summed stressed net must exceed RETURN_CONTRACTION summed stressed net.
RECEIVER_TIME_FIELD stressed net must be at least RETURN_CONTRACTION in at least two periods.
RECEIVER_TIME_FIELD actual net must be at least RETURN_CONTRACTION in at least two periods.
selection_order: Select RECEIVER_TIME_FIELD only if all operational, full-candidate and combined-attribution requirements pass.
Otherwise select RETURN_CONTRACTION only if all operational and full-candidate requirements pass.
Otherwise close NO_MECHANISM_PASSED and retain frozen CP2 economics.

stop_rules: Do not add another receiver, threshold, holding geometry, capital level or temporal period in V1.
Do not combine transition reserve or slot exchange in V1.
Do not adjust the frozen energy, dominance, lookback, hold or pass thresholds after outcomes are read.
Do not run a thirteenth rescue path.
Do not alter, query or restart Live.
